page.overview:
What is Mienfoo?

Mienfoo is a bipedal weasel or ferret-like Pokémon. It has yellow and maroon fur that piles around its arms and legs like a tunic or monk's robe with long sleeves. It often positions itself in a fighting stance. It has small red eyes and a pointed snout. There are gray oval markings above its eyes. Its legs are red, and its yellow tail has a red tip. It has one small whisker on either side of its face, and small round ears.

Despite their rather diminutive stature, Mienfoo are violent and ferocious. Any senseless person who approach will be faced with their brutal consecutive punches.

They can be observed practicing their series of poses in the morning which differ from pack to pack. Normally they seclude themselves in mountains to devote themselves in intense training.

Mienfoo evolves into Mienshao starting at level 50.
